entries.source: Android/iOS App Privacy Policy / অ্যাপ গোপনীয়তা নীতি
entries.target: Android/iOS App Privacy Policy / Patakaran sa Privacy ng App

entries.source: Account তৈরি করলে email address, account name এবং authentication identifier সংরক্ষণ করা হয়। Optional profile fields-এ user school/institution, nationality, city, phone number, JLPT target, preferred language, study goal, bio বা profile-related information যোগ করতে পারেন। Signed-in learning activity, progress এবং timestamps service functionality ও learning analytics-এর জন্য সংরক্ষণ করা হতে পারে। Authentication Supabase Auth দ্বারা পরিচালিত হয়; password Aponar Nihon database-এ plain text হিসেবে রাখা হয় না।
entries.target: Kapag gumawa ka ng account, iniimbak ang iyong email address, pangalan ng account at authentication identifier. Sa mga opsyonal na field ng profile, maaaring idagdag ng user ang paaralan/institusyon, nasyonalidad, lungsod, numero ng telepono, target sa JLPT, gustong wika, layunin sa pag-aaral, bio o impormasyong may kaugnayan sa profile. Maaaring iimbak ang aktibidad sa pag-aaral habang naka-sign in, progress at mga timestamp para sa paggana ng serbisyo at learning analytics. Pinamamahalaan ng Supabase Auth ang authentication; hindi iniimbak ang password bilang plain text sa database ng Aponar Nihon.

entries.source: Halal Scanner product barcode শনাক্ত করতে camera permission ব্যবহার করে। Barcode scan করার জন্য camera image/video Aponar Nihon account-এ upload বা media library হিসেবে সংরক্ষণ করা হয় না।
entries.target: Gumagamit ang Halal Scanner ng pahintulot sa camera para matukoy ang barcode ng produkto. Para mag-scan ng barcode, hindi ina-upload ang larawan/video ng camera sa account ng Aponar Nihon o iniimbak bilang media library.

entries.source: CV Builder-এ user নিজের CV photo নির্বাচন করলে photo-library permission ব্যবহার করা হয়। নির্বাচিত photo CV/PDF তৈরির কাজে ব্যবহৃত হয়।
entries.target: Sa CV Builder, kapag pinili ng user ang sariling larawan para sa CV, ginagamit ang pahintulot sa photo library. Ginagamit ang napiling larawan para gumawa ng CV/PDF.

entries.source: User চাইলে local daily study reminder চালু করতে notification permission ব্যবহার করা হয়। Reminder optional.
entries.target: Kung nais ng user, ginagamit ang pahintulot sa notification para paganahin ang lokal na pang-araw-araw na paalala sa pag-aaral. Opsyonal ang paalala.
Halal Scanner at paghahanap ng produkto

entries.source: Barcode scan করলে barcode/product lookup request Open Food Facts বা configured product-data provider-এ পাঠানো হতে পারে, যাতে product information পাওয়া যায়। Ingredient screening educational assistance; এটি official halal certification নয়। Verified certificate label কেবল যাচাইযোগ্য certifier/official source থাকা record-এর জন্য ব্যবহার করা হয়।
entries.target: Kapag nag-scan ng barcode, maaaring ipadala ang kahilingan sa paghahanap ng barcode/produkto sa Open Food Facts o sa naka-configure na provider ng data ng produkto, para makakuha ng impormasyon ng produkto. Ang pagsusuri ng sangkap ay tulong pang-edukasyon; hindi ito opisyal na sertipikasyon ng halal. Ginagamit lang ang label ng na-verify na sertipiko para sa mga record na may mabe-verify na certifier/opisyal na pinagmulan.

entries.source: AI Tutor ব্যবহার করলে user-এর পাঠানো প্রশ্ন, practice text এবং প্রয়োজনীয় conversation context Aponar Nihon API/Cloudflare infrastructure হয়ে configured AI service provider-এর কাছে requested response তৈরির জন্য process হতে পারে। AI Tutor-এ অপ্রয়োজনীয় password, banking credential, residence-card/passport number বা অন্য sensitive identifier না দেওয়া উচিত। AI Tutor prompt advertising profile তৈরির জন্য বিক্রি করা হয় না।
entries.target: Kapag ginamit ang AI Tutor, ang mga tanong na ipinadala ng user, teksto para sa pagsasanay at kinakailangang konteksto ng usapan ay maaaring iproseso sa pamamagitan ng Aponar Nihon API/Cloudflare infrastructure patungo sa naka-configure na provider ng AI service para makagawa ng hiniling na sagot. Hindi dapat magbigay sa AI Tutor ng hindi kinakailangang password, kredensyal sa bangko, numero ng residence card/pasaporte o iba pang sensitibong identifier. Hindi ibinebenta ang mga prompt ng AI Tutor para gumawa ng advertising profile.

entries.source: Native CV Builder user-এর entered CV data ও selected photo ব্যবহার করে PDF তৈরি করে এবং device share sheet দেয়। User নিজে share না করলে Aponar Nihon সেই generated PDF কোনো recipient-কে পাঠায় না। Future cloud-save/sync feature চালু হলে এই policy update করতে হবে।
entries.target: Gumagamit ang Native CV Builder ng inilagay na data ng CV ng user at napiling larawan para gumawa ng PDF at nagbibigay ng share sheet ng device. Kung hindi mismo ibinahagi ng user, hindi ipinapadala ng Aponar Nihon ang nabuong PDF na iyon sa sinumang tatanggap. Kapag inilunsad ang feature na cloud-save/sync sa hinaharap, kailangang i-update ang patakarang ito.

entries.source: Production service-এ Supabase (authentication/database), Cloudflare (hosting/API), configured AI provider (AI Tutor), এবং Open Food Facts বা configured product-data source (barcode lookup) ব্যবহার হতে পারে। Requested feature চালাতে প্রয়োজনীয় data এই providers-এর infrastructure-এ process হতে পারে।
entries.target: Sa production service, maaaring gamitin ang Supabase (authentication/database), Cloudflare (hosting/API), naka-configure na AI provider (AI Tutor), at Open Food Facts o naka-configure na pinagmulan ng data ng produkto (paghahanap ng barcode). Maaaring iproseso ang data na kailangan para patakbuhin ang hiniling na feature sa infrastructure ng mga provider na ito.

entries.source: Data account access, app functionality, learning progress, personalization, security, support এবং service improvement-এর জন্য ব্যবহার করা হয়। Aponar Nihon user data বিক্রি করে না এবং cross-company advertising tracking-এর উদ্দেশ্যে app data ব্যবহার করার জন্য design করা নয়।
entries.target: Ginagamit ang data para sa access sa account, paggana ng app, progress sa pag-aaral, personalization, seguridad, suporta at pagpapabuti ng serbisyo. Hindi ibinebenta ng Aponar Nihon ang data ng user at hindi ito idinisenyo para gamitin ang data ng app para sa cross-company advertising tracking.

entries.source: HTTPS network transport, authenticated sessions, native secure session storage এবং database Row Level Security ব্যবহার করা হয়। Native client-এ Supabase publishable key থাকে; service-role/server secret client app-এ রাখা হয় না। Internet service-এ absolute security guarantee করা যায় না।
entries.target: Ginagamit ang HTTPS network transport, mga authenticated session, native secure session storage at Row Level Security ng database. May Supabase publishable key ang native client; hindi iniimbak ang service-role/server secret sa client app. Hindi magagarantiya ang ganap na seguridad sa isang internet service.

entries.source: Account active থাকা পর্যন্ত account-related data রাখা হতে পারে। Account এবং associated app data delete করার information/flow-এর জন্য
entries.target: Maaaring panatilihin ang data na may kaugnayan sa account habang aktibo ang account. Para sa impormasyon/flow para tanggalin ang account at kaugnay na data ng app,

entries.source: ব্যবহার করুন। আইনগত বা নিরাপত্তাজনিত বাধ্যতামূলক retention প্রয়োজন না হলে account-linked profile/progress/activity data deletion flow-এর মাধ্যমে সরানো হয়। Device-local generated CV/reminder data device/app data clear করেও সরানো যায়।
entries.target: Gamitin ito. Maliban kung kailangan ng legal o seguridad na sapilitang pagpapanatili, inaalis ang data ng profile/progress/aktibidad na naka-link sa account sa pamamagitan ng deletion flow. Maaari ring alisin ang data ng CV/paalala na lokal sa device sa pamamagitan ng pag-clear ng data ng device/app.

entries.source: Aponar Nihon সাধারণ education service; এটি 13 বছরের কম বয়সী শিশুদের কাছ থেকে জেনে-বুঝে account data সংগ্রহের উদ্দেশ্যে তৈরি নয়।
entries.target: Ang Aponar Nihon ay isang pangkalahatang serbisyo sa edukasyon; hindi ito idinisenyo para sadyang mangolekta ng data ng account mula sa mga batang wala pang 13 taong gulang.
Mga pagbabago sa patakaran at pakikipag-ugnayan

entries.source: App feature, provider বা legal requirement পরিবর্তিত হলে এই policy update হতে পারে। Privacy বা account-related প্রশ্নের জন্য Aponar Nihon website-এর Contact/Support option ব্যবহার করুন।
entries.target: Maaaring ma-update ang patakarang ito kung magbago ang feature ng app, provider o legal na kinakailangan. Para sa mga tanong tungkol sa privacy o account, gamitin ang opsyong Contact/Support sa website ng Aponar Nihon.
